bounds.domain: One useModel dispatch over three registrations in dispatch order (provider alpha at priority 30 and 20, provider beta at 10) for TEXT_SMALL or TEXT_TO_SPEECH. Each registration answers or fails with one of eight errors: a refused connection on the AI SDK error's cause, a retry envelope whose lastError carries Bun's ConnectionRefused on its cause, an HTTP 400, a funding authority denial, a processing-policy denial or an AbortError whose cause is a refused connection, a caller abort followed by a refused connection, or an exhausted provider retry budget.
bounds.limitations: The implementation check replays all 90 reachable dispatches through AgentRuntime.useModel on a real SQLite runtime with the production classifier and dispatch loop; the handlers throw the modeled error shapes instead of calling a provider. Retries inside one provider (the SDK's own retries and generateTextWithTransientRetry) are bounded by the plugin-openai wire test, not by this model. HTTP 5xx and 429 statuses, message heuristics, local-inference availability, a pinned provider, streaming output already started, preparation rejections, error graphs deeper or more complex than the listed shallow wrappers (including cycles); production funding and cancellation checks walk the full cycle-safe graph, while transport-code lookup remains bounded to 12 nodes and cross-model-type fallback chains are outside this model.
